referenceSources.title: Lot 80 - 1992 Saab 900 S Aero Turbo
referenceSources.description:
A resplendent Talladega Red 1992 Saab 900 S Aero Turbo stands in a white‑walled showroom, its grey lower body cladding and three‑spoke alloy wheels emphasizing its sporty hatchback silhouette. The UK registration plate J827 UPA and the “turbo” badge on the front grille highlight its performance pedigree. Inside, grey leather upholstery and a sunroof complete the Aero specification.

This Saab has been tuned by Abbott Racing, featuring a limited‑slip differential, chargecooler kit, stainless steel exhaust, and ITG Sports air filter. With 145,000 miles on the odometer, manual transmission, and an MOT valid until July 2025, it represents one of only 83 licensed examples in the UK. Sold for £12,075 (including buyer’s premium and VAT) at Manor Park Classics’ 7th December 2024 auction, it comes with a full service history, owner’s manual, and two sets of keys.
